sections.section: RULE - Punjab District Government Rules of Business 2001
sections.description:
PUNJAB DISTRICT GOVERNMENT RULES
PUNJAB DISTRICT GOVERNMENT RULES
OF BUSINESS, 2001
(Amendment of R.16)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, Part I,
10th November, 2010]
No.SOR(LG)5-9/2001, dated 10-11-2010.---In exercise of the powers
conferred under section 191 of the Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 2001
(XIII of 2001), the Governor of the Punjab is pleased to direct that the
following amendment in the Punjab District Government rules of Business, 2001
shall be made:--
In the said rules, in rule 16, in
sub-rule (1), after clause (iii), the following proviso shall be inserted:
"Provided that the Deputy District
Officer (Revenue) may make posting and transfer of officials in BS-1 to
BS-10."
